preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within the valid range.
The number of pairs of interesting vertices k is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in pairs)
preconditions.description: Each pair of interesting vertices is within the valid range and distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of pairs of interesting vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) and 0 <= line < 1000000007 for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer within the specified modulo range.
